newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ministry says Giat sale not envisaged.
newsitem.headline: French ministry says Giat sale not envisaged.

text.p: The French Defence Ministry denied a report on Wednesday that it was considering adding arms maker Giat Industrie to the list of state companies to be privatised.

"The Defence Ministry states that the addition of Giat and (explosives maker) SNPE to the list of companies to be privatised is not part of, and will not be part of, the draft on state asset sales," it said in a statement.

The Figaro newspaper on Wednesday reported that the government was considering adding them to the list to enable the companies to take part in a Europe-wide restructuring of the arms industry, citing unnamed defence ministry sources.
It said Giat was currently unable to create a joint munitions venture it had envisaged with Britain's Royal Ordnance, but the project might be revived if Giat were slated for privatisation.
The Socialist-led CFDT union said on Tuesday that it opposed any such move.
